title: ComicInfo 2.1 JSON Schema
description: JSON representation of the ComicInfo 2.1 model, adapted from the ComicInfo 2.1 XSD. Every schema element includes a description suitable for automatic class and attribute documentation. ComicPageInfo additionally requires ImageBase64 to store the page image directly in the JSON document.

Series.description: The series name to which the comic belongs.

Number.description: The issue or volume number within the series.

Count.description: The total number of issues in the series or collection.

Volume.description: The volume number of the series.

AlternateSeries.description: An alternate series name for the comic.

AlternateNumber.description: The issue number in the alternate series.

AlternateCount.description: The total number of issues in the alternate series or collection.

Summary.description: A summary or synopsis of the comic.

Year.description: The publication year of the comic.

Month.description: The publication month of the comic.

Day.description: The publication day of the comic.

Writer.description: The writer or writers of the comic.

Penciller.description: The penciller or pencillers of the comic.

Inker.description: The inker or inkers of the comic.

Colorist.description: The colorist or colorists of the comic.

Letterer.description: The letterer or letterers of the comic.

CoverArtist.description: The cover artist or cover artists of the comic.

Editor.description: The editor or editors of the comic.

Translator.description: The translator or translators of the comic.

Imprint.description: The imprint under which the comic was published.

Genre.description: The genre or genres of the comic.

Web.description: A web URL associated with the comic.

PageCount.description: The number of pages in the comic.

LanguageISO.description: The ISO language code of the comic.

Format.description: The format or publication format of the comic.

BlackAndWhite.description: Indicates whether the comic is black and white.

Manga.description: Indicates whether the comic is manga and, when applicable, whether it should be read right-to-left.

Characters.description: The characters appearing in the comic.

Teams.description: The teams appearing in the comic.

Locations.description: The locations appearing in the comic.

ScanInformation.description: Information about the scanning or digital source of the comic.

StoryArc.description: The story arc to which the comic belongs.

StoryArcNumber.description: The number of the comic within the story arc.

SeriesGroup.description: The group or collection associated with the series.

AgeRating.description: The age rating assigned to the comic.

CommunityRating.description: The community rating of the comic.

MainCharacterOrTeam.description: The main character or team featured in the comic.

GTIN.description: The Global Trade Item Number associated with the comic.

YesNo.description: Indicates whether a property is unknown, false, or true.

Manga.description: Indicates whether the comic is manga and supports a right-to-left reading mode.

Rating.description: A community rating from 0 to 5, in increments of 0.1.

AgeRating.description: The age classification assigned to the comic.

ComicPageType.description: The type or types assigned to a comic page.

Image.description: The zero-based index of the page image.

Type.description: The type or types assigned to the page.

DoublePage.description: Indicates whether the page represents a double-page spread.

ImageSize.description: The size of the page image in bytes.

Key.description: A key identifying the page image.

Bookmark.description: The bookmark associated with the page.

ImageWidth.description: The width of the page image in pixels.

ImageHeight.description: The height of the page image in pixels.

ImageBase64.description: Base64-encoded page image data. This property is required by the ComicBookJson adaptation of ComicInfo 2.1.

ComicPageInfo.description: Information describing a comic page and its embedded image.

ArrayOfComicPageInfo.description: The collection of pages belonging to the comic.
